label: PF Backlog 608
title: RCCA (process, P0): partial delivery reported as complete - EDP-02 closed without store classification/mapping; add artifact-completeness gates + evidence-based DoD + re-open audit

decisions.note: Gate 1 (design 9cbaa9a7472f): evidence-based DoD gate + bounded baseline + RCCA. Follow-ups deferred.
Gate 2: delivery-completeness gate + RCCA delivered (diff ff439ed9db0c); follow-ups deferred.

brief.what_adds: Artifact-completeness gates + evidence-based DoD + re-open/audit falsely-closed items so partial work cannot pass
brief.problem: Partial discovery work was reported/closed as complete (no classification/mapping), and nothing caught it

objective: RCCA for EDP-02 being closed without store classification/mapping: record root cause, corrective and preventive actions, add an evidence-based delivery-completeness gate (no placeholder DoD) and a re-open audit for legacy completions.
acceptance_criteria: RCCA recorded on the item: root cause (closure verified artifact existence, not completeness; generic ACs allowed; no independent completeness check for discovery artifacts), corrective action (BI-PF-1408 completed classification/mapping/relationships), preventive guard, fixed_where and detection path.

New gate scripts/dev/delivery_completeness_check.py fails a completion transition when any acceptance criterion or verification entry is a placeholder (empty, equals the title/objective, starts with 'Objective achieved:', or is 'Not specified.'), requiring at least one specific AC and one specific verification.

The same gate requires an rcca block (root_cause, corrective, preventive, fixed_where) for items whose title/AC mentions RCCA, and reports (fails) completed items with placeholder DoD unless grandfathered in config/delivery-completeness-baseline.json.

Re-open audit evidence: BI-PF-1294 (EDP-02) is annotated with links.reopened_by=BI-PF-1408 and a decision note; the audit output reports the remaining placeholder completions (baseline count) to drive to zero.
The gate is wired into precheck fast and ci-cd-gates.json, supports --report (dry-run) and --self-test (placeholder, RCCA, baseline, clean cases), and has tests under test-framework/tests.
in_scope: Evidence-based DoD gate (placeholder AC/verification, RCCA block, baseline report) wired into precheck/CI.
out_of_scope: Re-opening and re-delivering every legacy item with placeholder DoD (inventory reported; grooming handles).
approach: 1) delivery_completeness_check.py: placeholder predicate + completion-transition enforcement + completed-item audit with baseline. 2) RCCA block on this item and links to BI-PF-1408/BI-PF-1294. 3) precheck/ci wiring, tests, docs note.
verification: Objective achieved: RCCA (process, P0): partial delivery reported as complete - EDP-02 closed without store classification/mapping; add artifact-completeness gates + evidence-based DoD + re-open audit
risks: Baseline hides legacy placeholders until grooming (reported, bounded).
Placeholder detection is heuristic (title/objective echo); combined with AC length/verification gates.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend delivery/engineering-complete endpoints with a reusable artifact-completeness validator: per-lane required-artifact manifest (EDP-02 must include store classification + mapping) checked fail-closed before any 'complete' status persists. Derive the gate from a declarative manifest (config) rather than hardcoding. Wire re-open audit: log reopen events, record evidence references, and trigger auto-RCCA via existing /issues/{iid}/rcca flow (reuse BI-PF-1246 reconciliation).
dependency_findings: REQUIRES BI-PF-0448 fail-closed guard pattern in delivery lane (same code path)
RELATED BI-PF-1246 (reuse auto-RCCA on validation FAIL)
RELATED BI-PF-1292 EDP-02 (data plane) - defines which store classification artifacts exist
conflict_findings: core/delivery.py likely touched by BI-PF-1246/0448 - serialize or coordinate PRs
engineering complete endpoint may be modified by multiple gate items - centralize validator to avoid divergence
duplication_findings: BI-PF-1246 covers auto-RCCA on validation FAIL - reuse its reconciliation hook, do not reimplement RCCA creation
BI-PF-0448 covers fail-closed delivery context gates - align artifact gate with that gate family, share guard pattern
artifact_store/asset_store already track artifacts - reuse as evidence source, no new store
analysis.rationale: The gap is an enforcement hole, not a new capability: existing stores + delivery APIs can gate closures and record evidence with modest extension, reusing BI-PF-0448 guard pattern and BI-PF-1246 auto-RCCA. No new component needed.
assumptions: EDP-02 required artifacts = store classification doc + store mapping (per EDP-02 spec)
Re-open is an explicit audited action, not automatic revert without human/RCCA link
artifact_store/asset_store hold evidence with stable IDs usable as DoD references
risks: Manifest over-specification could block legitimate partial deliveries - needs lane-scoped rules
Existing completed items (EDP-02 already closed) lack artifacts - re-open triggers a backlog of remediation
Conflicts with in-flight delivery-gate work could cause merge churn
evidence: Candidate APIs include /delivery and /engineering/assignments/{item_id}/complete as closure points to gate
Existing stores (artifact_store, asset_store, forge_store) provide evidence backing for completeness checks
BI-PF-1246 already established validation-FAIL -> auto-RCCA pipeline to reuse
missing_info: Canonical list of required artifacts per work-item type/lane (especially EDP-02)
Whether historical closed items are auto re-opened or grandfathered
Who reviews re-open decisions (owner vs. governance board)
RCCA SLA and severity mapping for completeness failures

context_review.reason: Every field just repeats the title; no specifics on which artifacts are missing, what the completeness gates or evidence-based DoD should look like, no affected components/files, and no concrete acceptance criteria.

api_impact.reason: precheck/CI tooling + RCCA record; no runtime API surface

rcca.detected_by: BI-PF-1408 discovery (233/235 stores unclassified after EDP-02 was closed)
rcca.impact: EDP-02 reported complete while classification/mapping/relationships were missing; downstream items assumed discovery done.
rcca.root_cause: Closure verified artifact existence (a registry file) instead of artifact completeness; the AC was a restatement of the objective; no independent completeness gate and no evidence-based DoD for discovery deliverables.
rcca.corrective: BI-PF-1408 delivered slices A/B/C (classification, targets, relationships) and the store-registry gates.
rcca.preventive: delivery-completeness gate: completion transitions reject placeholder AC/verification and require an RCCA block for RCCA items; completed-item audit reports remaining placeholders against a bounded baseline.
